schools.name: Universitas Indonesia

location.address: Kampus UI, Depok 16424 (as shown for SIMAK UI office)

schools.notes: Status: negeri (PTN-BH). Lokasi di sumber riset: Kota Depok. UKT group (1-11 in 2025/2026 and 2026/2027) is assigned per student based on the paying capacity of whoever finances the student; a non-subsidised middle/upper-income family should plan for the programme's top group (e.g. Pendidikan Dokter UKT 11 = Rp20.000.000/semester; Ilmu Komputer UKT 9 = Rp14.600.000). SNBP/SNBT pay UKT only; Jalur Mandiri pays the same UKT table plus a one-time IPI whose tier follows the UKT group (IPI 1 for UKT 1-2 = Rp0 up to IPI 4 for UKT 9-11, e.g. Rp120.000.000 for Pendidikan Dokter). KKI (international class) pays a flat UKT plus IPI. Faculty left null: the decrees/articles list programmes only. Overseas-status registration: Rp1.100.000/semester (reguler/mandiri), Rp2.475.000/semester (KKI). Trend: for the five sampled S1 programmes, 2025/2026 UKT (Kompas, citing SK 681/2025) and 2025/2026 IPI (SK 688/2025) equal the 2026/2027 values; 2024/2025 (Kontan) used 5 groups whose top amounts were close to today's top groups (e.g. Manajemen Rp14.650.000 in 2024 vs Rp14.600.000 in 2025/2026 and 2026/2027), so the restructuring mainly added lower/middle groups rather than raising the ceiling.

S1 UKT uses groups I-VIII (most programmes I-VII; Kedokteran I-VI), assigned by the economic capacity of parents/guardians. The same UKT applies to SNBP, SNBT and Seleksi Mandiri; SM-IPB entrants additionally pay a one-time BPIF in three tiers (the page does not say how the tier is chosen). Plan-for figures: Kedokteran top UKT Rp20.000.000/semester + BPIF Rp135.000.000-150.000.000 (mandiri); Agribisnis top UKT Rp10.000.000 + BPIF Rp63.000.000-70.000.000. Trend: sampled UKT (2024/2025 Kompas) and BPIF (2024 via IDN Times) are identical to the 2026 official figures. Kerjasama/BUD and Kelas Internasional pay a flat UKT (heading says 'Tahun 2025') plus a larger BPIF.

schools.name: Universitas Gunadarma
schools.notes: Status: swasta. Lokasi di sumber riset: Kota Depok (per research brief; not stated in the opened sources). Private fee model: one-time USP (uang gedung) by admission grade AA/A/B + BPP each semester + a per-SKS charge. Official admission hosts could not be read (ppmb: proxy 502/private-IP; pendaftaran: Cloudflare 403; baak: 403), so only secondary sources are used; they disagree for Sistem Komputer. Treat all Gunadarma figures as [Low confidence]; this needs verification. Address not captured from an opened source.

schools.name: Politeknik Negeri Jakarta

location.address: Jalan Prof. DR. G.A. Siwabessy, Kampus UI, Depok 16425

schools.notes: Status: negeri (PTN-BLU; per decree 'Instansi Pemerintah Yang Menerapkan Pola Pengelolaan Keuangan Badan Layanan Umum'). Lokasi di sumber riset: Kota Depok. UKT groups 1-8 (+KIP). Mandiri entrants are placed only in UKT VI-VIII and pay a one-time IPI (Rp12.500.000 or Rp10.500.000 in sampled programmes). Amounts come from official decree annexes that list per-candidate assignments (personal data omitted), not from a published tariff table; the PNJ admissions HTML pages returned 403. For every sampled programme, the UKT 6-8 amounts observed for SNBT 2025/2026 equal those in the 2026/2027 mandiri decree (different tracks, so this is indicative, not a same-track comparison).

schools.name: Universitas Pembangunan Nasional "Veteran" Jakarta
schools.notes: Status: negeri. Lokasi di sumber riset: Kota Depok (Limo campus, per research brief; not verified in this research). SNBP/SNBT: 8 UKT groups. Mandiri (SEMA): one flat UKT - in every sampled programme it equals the SNBP/SNBT top group (Kelompok 8) - plus a one-time IPI in three payment groups. Only news sources (detik; Kontan crediting PENMARU UPNVJ) could be read. Both list S1 Ilmu Politik's top UKT as the unusual 'Rp 6.202.000' - recorded as published, may be a typo upstream. Faculty names and campus address not captured from opened sources.

schools.name: Universitas Djuanda

location.address: Jl. Tol Ciawi No 1 Bogor 16720, Jawa Barat (as printed on the brochure 'Sekretariat PMB')

schools.notes: Status: swasta. Lokasi di sumber riset: Bogor (Ciawi). Private flat-fee model: one-time Pendaftaran + Prakuliah + SPS (uang gedung), then a fixed SPP per semester that already includes SKS, UTS and UAS (praktikum extra). Brochure: 'Angsuran Pertama minimal: Rp. 5.000.000,-'; wave badges show 50%/30%/20%/10% (badge fine print not fully legible; the top-left tag reads 'Beasiswa SPS 50% di Gelombang Perdana'). Figures transcribed from an image - [Medium confidence] in transcription; re-check against the brochure before publishing.

schools.name: Universitas Ibn Khaldun Bogor
schools.notes: Status: swasta (Yayasan Pendidikan Islam Ibn Khaldun Bogor). Lokasi di sumber riset: Bogor (per research brief and the decree's 'Bogor' dateline). New-student schedule for Kelas Reguler: SPP Rp2.500.000 per semester for all sampled programmes, plus semester-I SKS/UAS charges (20 SKS), a two-instalment DSP (Rp4.000.000-4.500.000 per instalment in sampled programmes), and small one-off items. spmb.uika-bogor.ac.id/biaya-kuliah failed TLS verification (incomplete certificate chain; not bypassed) and WebFetch got 503; the same schedule was found as an image on the official siakad PMB portal. Transcribed from an image - [Medium confidence] in transcription, although every sampled row sums to its printed total.
